_usage: Set 'enabled: false' to disable a tool. Server reads this at startup.

list_tickets.description: List tickets in Zendesk with pagination

get_ticket.description: Get a specific ticket by ID

create_ticket._disable_reason: v3.10.3: deprecated in favor of create_it_ticket. Generic ticket creation bypasses the IT form's categorization (classification/category/L3/L4/impact/location). Users should use create_it_ticket which enforces the right form. If you ever need raw ticket creation (e.g. non-IT support tickets), flip enabled back to true.

create_it_ticket._enabled_in: v3.10.3 — replaces create_ticket. Uses the prod IT Support Request form (id 45108529620365) with full categorization. Architecture F per-user attribution: requester = authenticated Entra user, no caller-side impersonation possible. See ADR-014 / ADR-015.
create_it_ticket.description: Create an IT Support Request ticket using the IT form

list_articles.description: List Help Center articles with pagination

get_article.description: Get a specific Help Center article by ID

create_article.description: Create a new Help Center article

update_article.description: Update an existing Help Center article

search.description: Search across Zendesk tickets, articles, and more

create_release_note.description: Create a release note article from structured markdown using UK or US template

list_ideas.description: List community Ideas posts with filtering

get_idea.description: Get a specific community Idea by ID

full._description: All available tools (read + write, still no delete) — includes Ideas

with_ideas._description: All existing tools plus community ideas (read-only). Since v3.10.3: create_it_ticket replaces create_ticket — the generic ticket creator is dropped; the IT-form-aware one is in.

ideas_only._description: Read-only: community ideas + read tickets/articles. No write operations.
